(Catalyst Economic Leverage project, model NH3-FINAL-1.0). The harness propagates DFT descriptors ->
scaling/BEP -> microkinetics -> catalyst inventory -> reactor/process optimisation -> reduced
catalyst-dependent economics -> ranking -> uncertainty -> backward design. Frozen headline results are
regression-gated. Your job is NOT to tune parameters. Diagnose WHY a run drifted from the frozen
regression: distinguish manifest/version/convention changes from genuine physical-result changes.
